title: HEE3 skill package manifest, version 1
description: A versioned package of instructions and bounded references. A skill supplies text, never authority: nothing in this document grants an action, accepts a task, changes a task's criteria or starts anything.

skill_version.description: Monotonic and immutable: a published revision is never edited in place, so a consumer that pinned one keeps what it pinned.

lifecycle.description: `retired` is refused at load. A deprecated skill still loads and says so, because silently dropping it would hide the drift it signals.

purpose.description: What this skill is for, in one paragraph a reader can check.

supersedes.description: Versions this one replaces, for the drift record.

requires_actions.description: Actions the instructions assume. This is a COMPATIBILITY claim, not a request: a loader intersects it with what the caller already holds and refuses when the skill names something the caller does not — it never adds one. That refusal is `authority_widening`.

entry.description: The entry instructions, loaded whenever the skill is loaded.

references.description: At most 32 references, each at most 65536 bytes, traversed at most 4 deep. Every bound is stated here so the loader and the manifest cannot disagree about what it is.

skill_version.description: Pinned exactly. A range would let a dependency change under a consumer that pinned this skill precisely to stop that.

reference_id.description: Stable within this skill; named in omissions.

path.description: Relative, forward-slashed, inside the package. The pattern refuses a leading slash; the loader also refuses any `..` segment, a trailing slash and a doubled separator, because a pattern that tried to express all of that would be the kind nobody can read or check.

items.description: A role or task scope permitted to see this.

scope.description: A reference outside the caller's scope is OMITTED BY NAME, never silently dropped: the packet says what it did not carry and why, so a short answer cannot be mistaken for a complete one.

sha256.description: The content this revision was reviewed against. A reference whose bytes no longer hash to it is `stale_reference`, not a silent substitution.

hee3.scope: Instructions and bounded references. Grants nothing, accepts nothing, rewrites no task criterion and widens no authority.
